meaning: to enjoy together; to have fun together with others

example.hakka: 過年當無閒,大家來同樂。
example.romanization: Kuo-ngiàn dong mò-hàng, thai-kâ lòi thùng-lo̍k.
example.english: New Year is very busy, so let's all get together and have fun.

note: Often seen on banners and invitations for community events, as in 同樂會 (a fun get-together). It carries a warm, communal feeling rather than just 'having fun' alone.
